questions.question: Simplify: (2/3) ÷ (4/5)
questions.explanation: Dividing by a fraction means multiplying by its reciprocal: (2/3) ÷ (4/5) = (2/3) × (5/4) = 10/12 = 5/6.
questions.fastStrategy: Division of fractions: multiply by reciprocal.

questions.question: Simplify: (1/2) + (1/3) + (1/4)
questions.fastStrategy: Find LCD; convert all fractions; add numerators.

questions.question: Simplify: (1/(x + 1)) + (1/(x - 1))
questions.fastStrategy: For rational expressions, find LCD and convert before combining.

questions.question: What is 2 (1/3) as an improper fraction?
questions.fastStrategy: Mixed to improper: (whole × denominator + numerator) / denominator.
